title: The wand bank
steps: After so many years, Eldra is finally holding her own book again.
I thank thee from the bottom of my heart, young wizard. Thou hast brought peace to a very old soul.
You reach the end of the aisle, where the wand bank is. Behind its counter stands Baro, a pupil's father, who keeps it in the mornings.
Welcome, first-years. Here are your school wands for the year, one for you and one for {mate}. Look after them well.
{wizard}! I came to the library for a book and heard your voice through the shelves. I knew it was you at once! It is so good to see you again.
It is great to see you too! {mate}, this is {friend}, who met me at the gate and taught me. And {friend}, this is {mate}, my dormitory mate.
Hello, {friend}. It is very nice to meet you. {wizard} told me all about how you opened the great gate together!
And since I finally have my own school wand, here is your spare wand back. Thank you so much for lending it to me!

You did wonderfully. You learned to ask what a thing knows, its attribute, and to keep what a method gives back under a name, a variable. You opened doors with their own method, found a hidden key and a distance that changes, and drew books down with *fendra*!
As you leave, you look out the windows and see it is already dusk. Nearby, you hear older pupils whispering a rumour: at night, the passages of the castle change and come alive.
